calibration.caveat: The three reference profiles are approximated from public dimensions and press images (see their `sources`), not pixel-measured. Bands below separate sleek from toy on THIS set. Re-run `oh design calibrate` with measured silhouettes (`--ref image.png`) before using any band as a hard gate.

measured.M1_not_computed_reason: needs the frame/servo model and the CAD geometry gate (T-0004 / cad check); not derivable from an outer mesh

P8b.name: Shank taper: ankle / calf section area

P9a.name: Thigh widest point, fraction of length from the top

P9b.name: Calf widest point, fraction of shank from the top

S1a.name: Front silhouette IoU vs approved D1

S1b.name: Side silhouette IoU vs approved D1

S3a.name: Silhouette ledges (horizontal steps in the outer edge)

S3b.name: Unintended bumps in the leg width profile

S4a.name: Share of surface in flat patches >= 0.002 H^2

S4b.name: Largest flat patch / its part's area

HP.name: Every hard point enclosed with wall + gap
